notes.md: - **BIMSTEC Grid Interconnection:** MoU signed at the **4th BIMSTEC Summit, Kathmandu (31 Aug 2018)**; it set up the **BIMSTEC Grid Interconnection Coordination Committee (BGICC)** for power-grid cooperation.
- **AP Non-Resident Telugu Society (APNRTS):** set up by the AP Government in **May 2016**, chaired by the **Chief Minister**; serves the Telugu diaspora.
- **IONS members:** **25 members and 9 observers** (34 navies); South Korea became the latest observer (2023).
